posts.content: 免費網上培訓：2026 年 12 月 16 日，Monica Bhatara 主講用表達性治療調節創傷復元中的神經系統。
posts.title: Free Online Training for Therapists & Mental Health Professionals（2026 年 12 月 16 日研討會）

summary_en: The Mind Body Training Institute's free monthly support webinar takes place on Wednesday 16 December 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (about 5:00 a.m. Hong Kong time on 17 December), presented by Canadian trauma therapist and national trainer Monica Bhatara: 'Using Expressive Therapies to Support Regulating the Nervous System Within Trauma Recovery Work'. The session explores how expressive and somatic therapies offer creative, sensory-based ways to support nervous system regulation and help clients process traumatic experiences, adaptable for children and adults within trauma-informed practice. Bhatara has over 25 years of clinical and leadership experience, informed by Polyvagal Theory and Indigenous Psychology. Attendance is free and registrants can access replays.
summary_zh: Mind Body Training Institute 每月免費支援研討會，2026 年 12 月 16 日星期三 13:00（美國太平洋時間，約香港時間 12 月 17 日 05:00），由加拿大創傷治療師及全國培訓師 Monica Bhatara 主講「用表達性治療支援創傷復元中的神經系統調節」。講座介紹表達性與身體取向治療如何以創意及感官方式支援神經系統調節、協助個案處理創傷經驗，適用於兒童及成人，並融入創傷知情實務。Bhatara 有 25 年以上臨床及領導經驗，取向受多重迷走神經理論與原住民心理學啟發。費用全免，登記即可參加及收看重播。
supervision_questions: 個案用言語表達唔到創傷經驗時，你會點判斷幾時適合引入表達性或身體取向練習？
